name: Depth-First Splat Sorting
definition: Sorting the list of staged splats by depth *before* creating per-tile fragments, unlike 3DGS which sorts fragments after splitting. This reduces sorting costs because the number of fragments is 1.5 to 4x higher than visible splats.
summary: Depth-First Splat Sorting reduces rendering overhead by sorting visible Gaussian splats by depth before fragment creation, lowering computational cost compared to sorting fragments directly.
